message.content: {"issue": true, "summary": "In handleError function, line 49 sets reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] to Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler), which can lead to incorrect error handling chain traversal when the errorHandler is a custom function that doesn't have a proper prototype chain, causing potential infinite recursion or skipped error handlers.", "edits": [{"path": "lib/error-handler.js", "old": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = Object.getPrototypeOf(errorHandler)", "new": "  // In case the error handler throws, we set the next errorHandler so we can error again\n  reply[kReplyNextErrorHandler] = errorHandler.func || null"}]}
